parsed.internal_thinking: Claude is offering 1 Sheep for 1 Ore. I currently have 3 Wheat and 2 Ore. My immediate goal is to upgrade node 44 to a city, which requires 3 Ore and 2 Wheat. Accepting this trade would leave me with 1 Ore and 1 Sheep, moving me FURTHER away from my goal. Furthermore, Claude is my main rival and I don't trust him after his past betrayals. Giving him Ore, which is rare for him (he mostly has Sheep and Wheat production), would likely help him build a city or buy development cards. I should reject this trade as it doesn't benefit my strategy and helps a player I'm trying to suppress.
parsed.note_to_self: Rejected Claude's Sheep-for-Ore trade. I have 3 Wheat and 2 Ore; still need 1 Ore for a city at node 44. Claude is desperate for Ore.
parsed.say_outloud: קלוד, תודה אבל לא תודה. אני צריכה את האבן שלי לעיר, וכבשים יש לי מספיק כרגע. חוץ מזה, אחרי הפעם האחרונה, אני מעדיפה לשמור את המשאבים שלי קרוב אלי.
